{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ottethans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Their [[Ottethan Empire|empire]] contained twelve [[Star system/Legends|systems]], of which the [[Ottethan system/Legends|Ottethan system]] was the capital, ruled by a [[Ottethan warlord|warlord]] around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].<ref name="Endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref>
